from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u086/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts={v:[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==v and v!=bg] for v in counts if v!=bg}
    # Extend any aligned diagonal motif through its extreme endpoint.
    for color, cells in pts.items():
        for dr in (-1,1):
            for dc in (-1,1):
                for r,c in cells:
                    rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                    if (rr,cc) in cells:
                        # Extend only when the aligned diagonal has another point or is the singleton ray marker.
                        r0,c0=r-dr,c-dc
                        if (r0,c0) in cells or len(cells)==1:
                            y,x=r,c
                            while 0<=y-dr<h and 0<=x-dc<w:
                                y-=dr; x-=dc
                                if out[y][x]==bg: out[y][x]=color
    return out
'''
(base/'task-fb366191.py').write_text(code)
